lines.text: Careful! The measuring device is having one of its days.

lines: It keeps telling me the same minute over and over.
Could you take a look? It is in my workshop.

choices.text: Later. I want to look around first.

lines.text: Really? Oh, thank you! I knew I could count on you.

lines: Go and look at it. I will stay out of the way. I am very good at that.

lines.text: Right. Of course. I will just... keep the minute company.

lines: It is a very stubborn minute.

lines.text: Have you looked at the device yet?

lines: It is on the bench in my workshop. Mind the spring.

lines.text: You actually looked! What did it say?
One minute before noon. Always. That is not a broken clock. That is a message.

lines: Thank you. I would not have asked anyone else.

lines.text: The device still loses a minute, but it loses it with you now.

lines: That is almost friendship, I think.
